train_CDiT_model: train a new CDiT model using DDP with configurable epochs, learning rate, and checkpoint intervals
evaluate_model_with_dreamsim: evaluate a trained CDiT model using DreamSim perceptual loss on a test dataset
update_ema_model: update the exponential moving average model weights towards the current model with configurable decay
load_checkpoint: load an existing model checkpoint including model weights, EMA weights, optimizer state, and training state
create_training_dataset: create a combined training dataset from multiple robot datasets with configurable context size and goals per observation
